name: semantic-clusters-shape
description: The FFI shape fixture (i9 M5, ADR-0008 lockstep): semantic_clusters over hand-built vectors must serialize to exactly this value in every crust. The embeddings are chosen so a~b and b~c clear the 0.92 threshold while a~c does not (the chained-restatement case), index 3 is a zero vector (no geometry, no claim), and index 4 is a singleton.
